headline: Application IAM policy widened to grant unrestricted S3 access

findings.evidence_ref: variables.tf: `app_data_bucket_arns` default changed from `["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data", "arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"]` to `["*"]`. The policy now permits `s3:GetObject`, `s3:PutObject`, and `s3:ListBucket` on all resources.
findings.explanation: The application role now has unrestricted read/write access to every S3 bucket in the account, not just the intended data bucket. This violates least-privilege by giving production app instances blanket permissions. If the application or an instance is compromised, attackers gain access to all S3 data including backups, artifacts, and any other buckets. The proper solution is to maintain the bucket ARN list in the variable, not to grant wildcard access.
